caption: Chad peaked in 1972, decades before internet memes, and fell below 100 births in 2024. #Chad #NameData #AIVoice
pinned_comment: Would you name a kid Chad today?
story_thesis: Chad peaked at 13,392 boys in 1972, fell below 100 in 2024, and reached 96 in 2025; the decline began before internet memes.
script: This meme name had already been falling. Chad peaked at 13,392 American boys in 1972. In 2024, it reached 90. The decline began decades before internet memes. Watch the long slide.
